pageSections.description: The study predicts NonDemented, VeryMildDemented, MildDemented, or ModerateDemented from a brain MRI image.
pageSections.context: Linked Colab experiments report a gain from 78% baseline accuracy to 85% after ensemble comparison and error analysis.

pageSections.title: The notebook executes five concrete stages

items.label: Discover
items.title: Discover 6,400 files
items.body: Mount Google Drive, enumerate MRI images, and map each parent folder to a class label.

items.label: Batch
items.title: Create 256×256 batches
items.body: Resize and rescale each image, then allocate training, validation, and test partitions using the declared 80/10/10 split.

items.label: Augment
items.title: Augment training images
items.body: Apply randomized image transformations inside the training pipeline to increase input variation.

items.label: Train
items.title: Train CNN variants
items.body: Run convolution, pooling, dropout, and dense classification layers against the same four labels.

items.label: Ensemble
items.title: Average model probabilities
items.body: Compare single-model predictions with two-model, three-model, and draft weighted ensembles.
